name: tweety family member 1

function.text: TTYH1 encodes protein tweety homolog 1. Annotated molecular activities include chloride channel activity and volume-sensitive chloride channel activity. It participates in chloride transport and L-glutamate transmembrane transport.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Embryonal tumor with multilayered rosettes. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.
